- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can renew their passport if it's valid for 9 years or less or if it's been expired for less than 15 years.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user needs to fill out Form DS-82 for passport renewal.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Required documents for passport renewal include the current passport, a completed Form DS-82, a photocopy of ID, and one recent color photograph.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The application fee for a U.S. passport book is currently $110 for adults and $80 for children.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user can track their application status online or by calling the National Passport Information Center at 1-877-487-2778.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for avoiding burnout in exercise include listening to the body, starting slow, prioritizing recovery, taking rest days, staying hydrated, and getting enough sleep.
